summary: Organism-level verifier specs for all round-009 runtime draft planner organisms. These specs aggregate existing atom verifier evidence into bounded document-class acceptance criteria without claiming broad autonomous template generation.

acceptance_checks: new line item rows are present in the source table
line total formulas extend to appended rows
SKU validation and formula-cell protection are preserved
printable invoice sheet materializes declared fields and line table
non_claims: does not render PDF or prove pagination
does not perform tax or accounting advice
specs.promotion_gate: Promote only after a single organism-level verifier aggregates all invoice preview atom results and workbook inspections.

acceptance_checks: expense rows are appended to the reimbursement item table
reimbursable-total formulas extend to appended rows
receipt-status validation, protected reimbursement formulas, and printable claim output are all present
non_claims: does not enforce company expense policy
specs.promotion_gate: Promote only after reimbursement fixtures verify appended expenses, receipt validation, formula protection, and printable claim layout together.

acceptance_checks: purchase-order line rows are appended to the order table
line-total formulas extend to appended rows
PO status validation, protected order formulas, and printable purchase order output are all present
non_claims: does not create vendor contract terms
specs.promotion_gate: Promote only after purchase-order fixtures verify line append, formula extension, status validation, protected totals, and printable order output together.

acceptance_checks: budget rows summarize by category
over-budget variance rows are highlighted
period roll-forward and protected summaries are either verified or explicitly absent from the selected plan
non_claims: does not create native pivot tables
specs.promotion_gate: Promote only after a budget fixture verifies summary, threshold, period copy, carry-forward, and protected summary in one flow.

acceptance_checks: cash-flow rows summarize by category or flow type
opening and closing balance formulas extend or roll forward without reference drift
copied period sheets and protected balance formulas are present when included in the plan
non_claims: does not create native pivot tables
specs.promotion_gate: Promote only after cash-flow fixtures verify summary, formula continuity, period copy, roll-forward mapping, and protected balance cells together.

acceptance_checks: attendance period sheet is copied when the plan includes period rollover
attendance status values are constrained by validation
attendance formulas or totals remain protected on the copied register
non_claims: does not auto-grow arbitrary attendance matrices
specs.promotion_gate: Promote only after attendance fixtures verify period copy, status validation, protected totals, and matrix-growth exclusions together.

acceptance_checks: timesheet period sheet is copied and new hour rows are appended
hour or pay formulas extend to appended rows
work-code validation and protected total formulas are present
specs.promotion_gate: Promote only after timesheet fixtures verify period copy, hour row append, formula extension, validation, and protected totals together.

acceptance_checks: timeline period sheet is copied when the plan includes period rollover
task progress formulas extend and task status values are validated
status summaries and protected progress formulas are present
non_claims: does not render a gantt chart
does not project arbitrary timeline grids
does not infer project scheduling policy
specs.promotion_gate: Promote only after timeline fixtures verify period copy, formula extension, status validation, status summary, and protected progress formulas together.

acceptance_checks: roster period sheet is copied when the plan includes week rollover
shift-code values are constrained by validation
coverage formulas on the roster remain protected
non_claims: does not auto-grow arbitrary roster matrices
specs.promotion_gate: Promote only after roster fixtures verify period copy, shift-code validation, protected coverage formulas, and staffing-policy exclusions together.

acceptance_checks: construction cost rows are appended to the cost table
variance or forecast formulas extend to appended rows
cost overrun rows are highlighted and protected formula ranges remain locked
specs.promotion_gate: Promote only after construction fixtures verify row append, variance formula extension, threshold highlighting, and protected forecast formulas together.

acceptance_checks: movement headers normalize to canonical names
stock master reconciliation reports matched, missing, and mismatch rows
movement formulas, lookup enrichment, and protected balance cells are either verified or explicitly absent from the selected plan
specs.promotion_gate: Promote only after an inventory fixture combines movement append, balance formulas, SKU enrichment, and reconciliation verification.

acceptance_checks: procurement invoice status values are constrained by validation
PO and invoice tables reconcile with deterministic match or mismatch output
review formulas remain protected after reconciliation
non_claims: does not perform three-way receipt matching
specs.promotion_gate: Promote only after procurement fixtures verify status validation, PO-to-invoice reconciliation, protected review formulas, and duplicate-key exclusions together.

acceptance_checks: SKU rows are enriched from the warehouse master lookup
low-stock or reorder rows are highlighted by deterministic thresholds
reorder candidate rows, SKU validation, and protected reorder formulas are present
non_claims: does not calculate reorder quantity policy
does not resolve duplicate SKU keys
specs.promotion_gate: Promote only after warehouse fixtures verify lookup enrichment, low-stock highlighting, candidate append, validation, and protected formulas together.

acceptance_checks: score rows summarize by student with deterministic totals
grade status values are constrained by validation
native pivot-style score distribution remains excluded from supported runtime claims
non_claims: does not create native Excel pivots
specs.promotion_gate: Promote only after score summary, validation, protected formulas, and matrix-growth semantics are checked in one organism verifier.

acceptance_checks: training completion rows summarize by employee or learner
training status values are constrained by validation
completion formulas remain protected and printable training report output is present
non_claims: does not auto-grow arbitrary training matrices
specs.promotion_gate: Promote only after training fixtures verify completion summary, status validation, protected formulas, printable report output, and matrix-growth exclusions together.

acceptance_checks: service ticket rows are appended to the queue table
SLA breach formulas extend to appended rows
ticket status validation, overdue highlighting, status summary, and protected SLA formulas are present
non_claims: does not route or assign tickets
does not create native queue dashboards
specs.promotion_gate: Promote only after ticket fixtures verify row append, SLA formula extension, status validation, overdue highlighting, summary, and protected formulas together.

acceptance_checks: sales deal rows are appended to the pipeline table
weighted-value formulas extend to appended rows
stage validation, large-deal highlighting, stage summary, and protected forecast formulas are present
non_claims: does not infer sales process policy
does not create native pipeline dashboards
specs.promotion_gate: Promote only after sales fixtures verify deal append, weighted formula extension, stage validation, threshold highlighting, summary, and protected formulas together.

acceptance_checks: maintenance issue rows are appended to the issue log
action-required formulas extend to appended rows
issue status validation, risk highlighting, status summary, and protected action formulas are present
non_claims: does not infer safety or maintenance policy
specs.promotion_gate: Promote only after maintenance fixtures verify issue append, formula extension, status validation, risk highlighting, summary, and protected formulas together.

acceptance_checks: compliance action rows are appended to the action register
review-required formulas extend to appended rows
action status validation, overdue highlighting, status summary, protected review formulas, and printable register output are present
specs.promotion_gate: Promote only after compliance fixtures verify action append, formula extension, status validation, overdue highlighting, summary, protected formulas, and printable output together.

acceptance_checks: safety check rows are appended to the safety register
action-required formulas extend to appended rows
safety status validation, risk highlighting, area completion summary, protected action formulas, and printable report output are present
specs.promotion_gate: Promote only after safety fixtures verify check append, formula extension, status validation, risk highlighting, completion summary, protected formulas, and printable output together.

acceptance_checks: payment-row formulas extend without reference drift
calculated interest, principal, and balance cells are protected
amortization correctness and financial advice are excluded until a dedicated calculation schedule verifier exists
specs.promotion_gate: Promote only after a calculation schedule verifier checks recurrence, termination policy, protected formulas, and editable inputs together.
